titulo: Trump’s state dinner for Xi Jinping will not be televised as White House continues to deny CNN full access – as it happened
cuerpo: This live blog is now closed. CNN and MS Now journalists denied access to White House state dinner despite court ruling Sign up for US Breaking News emails Lawyers for the news outlets President Trump banned from the White House have requested an emergency hearing after several journalists were turned away from the building Thursday morning, in apparent defiance of a federal judge’s order to restore their access. “This morning journalists from each of CNN, MS NOW, and POLITICO attempted to enter the White House and were turned away, and Secret Service agents confiscated the hard pass of journalists whose hard passes had not previously been confiscated,” a new court filing read.
